clips.title: The story
paras: Kravel Koalbeard wants the Fool's Stout tested on a pit crew at the Mirage Raceway. If you choose the goblins, you take the stout to the Goblin Pit Boss. The stout will go bad eventually, so Kravel says not to wait too long.

Kravel Koalbeard needs the Fool's Stout tried out on one of the pit crews. You may try it on the goblins: he hands you the stout and sends you with it to the Goblin Pit Boss, who is nearby at the Mirage Raceway. Choosing the goblins tips the races toward the gnomes. Kravel warns you not to dawdle, because the stout will go bad eventually.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We need to try the Fool's Stout on one of the pit crews. If you want to try it on the goblins, then here -- take the stout and give it to the goblin pit boss.
And don't wait too long. This stout will go bad eventually.

clips.title: Completion
paras: What do we have here? Booze, eh?
Well, I don't mind if we have just a little...
